item.title: LIEF v1.0.0
item.author: me@romainthomas.fr (Romain Thomas)
item.description: After nearly ten years, LIEF hits 1.0.0: a milestone release built around stability, usability and security. This release also introduces a brand-new cross-platform Runtime API for inspecting and manipulating live processes.
